lesson: Split hollow frame charts into posts and beams before conjoining and gate the page on hollow share <= 10%.
evidence: S14 kept frames whole: frame envelopes took about 2/3 of the page (68% hollow). split_hollow + space audit gates fixed it.
note: written into the skill in the same session

lesson: Conjoinment keeps every owner chart at its original UV size; only the final atlas step scales, uniformly.
evidence: S15 normalised density / filled the page and silently raised texel density; owner: "keep them same size as the original UV". S16 original-scale output accepted.
note: written into the skill in the same session

lesson: For architecture, merge same-material charts with similar dimensions aggressively (T3: +/-40%, IoU >= 0.6); exact containment is only the fallback for sensitive areas.
evidence: Exact (science) containment freed 4.5% of the page, owner: "almost ZERO change"; T3 + repack freed 14% and "reminds the AoE textures".
note: written into the skill in the same session

lesson: Test AO compatibility point to point (p95 <= 0.08, max <= 0.20) with samples guaranteed on small faces; face means and 6x6 bins miss beam ends, dots and window shadows.
evidence: S17: D1 mean left 15% of member texels > 0.20 error, D2 bins 6% and lost door-knob dots and beam ends; D6 points 2.9% and matched the unique reference.
cost: owner found beam ends and a dotted wall band by eye
note: written into the skill in the same session

lesson: Density checker is Blender's COLOR_GRID generated at each texture's own resolution, Closest sampling, through that page's UV layer.
evidence: Owner could not read the custom 16-texel checker: "use the same as GPT", "each resolution needs special texture", "make it standard for all future models".
note: written into the skill in the same session

lesson: Report density as weighted p10/p50/p90 per face, never only the median: parked hidden-density charts hide under a good median.
evidence: S18b: 17.6% of visible area sat at 15 texels/unit under a 118 median; restoring 225 charts gave S18c uniform 107 (p10-p90 107-112).
note: written into the skill in the same session

lesson: Compare density against vanilla with the same formulas (island sqrt(UV area x px / 3D area), effective sqrt(used texels / visible area)) and check model units first.
evidence: Korean TC S18c 107 island / 85 effective vs vanilla JP/CN town centres 116-139 / 77-92: a bit below / same level. Vanilla TCs 9-10 units, ours 9.1.
note: written into the skill in the same session

lesson: Do not measure packing with Blender's pack_islands; use the validated MaxRects packer (pack_rects.py).
evidence: pack_islands was 10% worse on 16 equal squares and exact-shape mode hung; MaxRects BSSF hits the 464/348/232 control optima.
note: written into the skill in the same session

lesson: Unwrap lathed shapes (pots, jars) as continuous profile bands developed as cone sectors, one seam per band.
evidence: Pots: profile bands density CV 0%, ABF / LSCM 32-40% CV. split_hollow needed a curved-chart guard (> 4 directions is not a frame).
note: written into the skill in the same session

lesson: Inspect multi-page atlases as UDIM tiles (1001 = 2048, 1002 = 1024, 1003 = 512) at each tile real resolution on one UV layer.
evidence: S18d UDIM view (Families, AO, Checker) - owner: "OK, this is fine."
note: written into the skill in the same session

lesson: An exact-shape nesting packer could lift page fill from 66-75% to the vanilla ~75%+.
evidence: S18c fill: 2048 page 74.6%, 1024 page 66.4%; MaxRects packs bounding rectangles only.

lesson: Verify that AoE3DE shades mirrored tangent space correctly before relying on normal maps on flipped family members.
evidence: 274 of 1286 member faces are mirrored (WOOD 200, EAVE_CUTOUT 48); ROOF_TILE members are not mirrored. Untested in game.

lesson: Check baked roof-tile rhythm on T3 members: up to +/-40% (one axis up to 67%) stretch may show as uneven tile rows; T2 is the fallback for that family.
evidence: 164 ROOF_TILE member faces share owner texels; AO passed, normal/colour rhythm was never tested.
